shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat AGENTS.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g '"'!.git/**'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "ls -a | head -25 && npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/date-utils version peerDependencies && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -45 && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-utils dateTime && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Text Button && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/README.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-utils dateTime && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Text Button && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/README.md'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'Calendar|settings|dateTime|locale' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/INDEX.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts && sed -n '1,145p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && cat index.html && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && rg -n -C 2 'width:|min-width:|size_l|--g-spacing-8|--g-border-radius-l' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/Calendar.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css"
